title: Absolute convergence implies convergence, Converges form
statement: forall f, (Exists M, Converges (sumRange (fun k => abs (f k))) M) -> Exists L, Converges (sumRange f) L -- absolute convergence implies convergence, in Converges form. Composes with sumRange_comparisonTest's own output (applied at fun k => abs (a k)) to give the comparison test on a SIGNED series a, which sumRange_comparisonTest cannot take directly since its first hypothesis is forall k, 0 <= a k. This is what makes the comparison and ratio tests usable on a signed series -- named explicitly in this batch's brief.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.sumRange_converges_of_abs_converges : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : Exists.{1} CReal (fun (x1 : CReal) => CReal.Converges (CReal.sumRange (fun (x2 : AxNat) => CReal.abs (x0 x2))) x1)) -> Exists.{1} CReal (fun (x2 : CReal) => CReal.Converges (CReal.sumRange x0) x2)))
